description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCursorHandler' that implements InvocationHandler, providing cursor management and proxy creation functionalities for JDBC operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractCursorHandler
classes.description: An abstract class implementing InvocationHandler, managing cursor name and fetch size, and providing proxy creation.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the cursor.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method invocation, customizing 'toString' output or delegating to the underlying object.

methods.description: Creates a new proxy instance for the specified interface using the provided invocation handler.
